class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Upload &amp; analyze files in Gemini Apps</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><p>You can upload documents, spreadsheets, notebooks, photos, videos, and more to Gemini Apps to get answers, summaries, and insights about your content.</p>

<h2>What you need</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ul class="no-margin">
  <li>If you’re signed in to a work or school Google Account:
    <ul>
      <li>To upload files from Google Drive,&nbsp;access to apps in Gemini must be enabled by your organization’s Workspace administrator.&nbsp;<a href="https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/6208960" rel="noopener">Learn about administrators</a>.</li>
      <li>Learn more about <a href="/gemini/answer/14620100" rel="noopener">using Gemini Apps with a work or school account</a> or <a href="/a/answer/15293691" rel="noopener">how to enable access to apps in Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

<div><p>To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><strong>Tip:</strong> To get higher limits for this feature, like the ability to upload&nbsp;more files or ask Gemini Apps to reference uploaded files in more chats, you can upgrade to a Google AI plan. Learn more <a href="/gemini/answer/16275805" rel="noopener">about limits</a> and&nbsp;<a href="/gemini/answer/14517446" rel="noopener">how to upgrade</a>.</div>

<gkms-context-selector id="14903473"></gkms-context-selector><h2 id="start_chat"><a id="add_file" name="add_file">Upload files &amp; code</a></h2>

<h3>In the Gemini web app</h3>

<div><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com/">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>In the text box at the bottom, enter your question or prompt.</li>
  <li>Click Add files <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc">.
    <ol>
      <li>To upload a supported file from your device: click <strong>Upload</strong> Files <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7F81WckVz8ZLqCRQdkskz29zM_CbUslXVGROonY91A4QqHRxJkAEmRfnOYX1T87mPUAq=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7F81WckVz8ZLqCRQdkskz29zM_CbUslXVGROonY91A4QqHRxJkAEmRfnOYX1T87mPUAq">.</li>
      <li>To add a code folder:<strong> </strong>click <strong>More Uploads</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"><strong> </strong><strong>Import Code</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Nmv-SzsyzxOZgJydq_RdiMO0IA5R-MPg2I6wa1xvtyVfdJAauHbPwhW3RAHdJbCJUw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Nmv-SzsyzxOZgJydq_RdiMO0IA5R-MPg2I6wa1xvtyVfdJAauHbPwhW3RAHdJbCJUw"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Upload folder</strong>.</li>
      <li>To add a GitHub repository:<strong> More Uploads</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"><strong> </strong><strong>Import Code</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Nmv-SzsyzxOZgJydq_RdiMO0IA5R-MPg2I6wa1xvtyVfdJAauHbPwhW3RAHdJbCJUw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Nmv-SzsyzxOZgJydq_RdiMO0IA5R-MPg2I6wa1xvtyVfdJAauHbPwhW3RAHdJbCJUw"> and enter the GitHub repository or branch URL. <a href="/gemini/answer/16176929" rel="noopener">Learn more about adding GitHub repositories</a>.</li>
      <li>To add a supported file from your Google Drive: click Add from Drive <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/G0gtMhFiQ4HhPVBnXnqrH6DX4JqcJrJ7OHCKmY-zOSmaI4T0aCDAiicTTbzhpgsPKA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/G0gtMhFiQ4HhPVBnXnqrH6DX4JqcJrJ7OHCKmY-zOSmaI4T0aCDAiicTTbzhpgsPKA">.
        <ol>
          <li>To add files from your Drive, you need to have <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Keep Activity</a> on and connect Google Workspace to Gemini Apps. If it’s not connected, you'll get the option to connect it. <a href="/gemini/answer/13594961#data_exchange" rel="noopener">Learn about your Gemini Apps and Google Workspace data</a>.</li>
        </ol>
      </li>
      <li>To add a&nbsp;notebook: click <strong>More Uploads</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Notebooks <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Notebook" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU">.</li>
    </ol>
  </li>
  <li>Click Submit <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<div><p><strong>Tips:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>You can add up to 10 (subject to availability) of any kind of supported file in the same prompt, such as documents, images, or videos.</li>
  <li>If you get an error that Gemini failed to analyze your file correctly, re-upload it.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="gic" name="gic">In Gemini in Chrome</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>Open Chrome and navigate to a page you want to analyze or summarize.</li>
  <li>At the top of your browser, click Gemini in Chrome <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/-bfA1EBV7vymjXLaZjBywKipI8STl-kiOmo1nGo6vOb571REo5REGJFVcu7VmtVeRpy9=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/-bfA1EBV7vymjXLaZjBywKipI8STl-kiOmo1nGo6vOb571REo5REGJFVcu7VmtVeRpy9">.</li>
  <li>At the bottom of the text box, enter your question or prompt.</li>
  <li>Click Add files <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7J3JiMnso9z_5Yf5MlVC3n9hc52VGnAo5UwVaypBhRYMZ_XF1xBSq-p13zVmPJmI7Q=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7J3JiMnso9z_5Yf5MlVC3n9hc52VGnAo5UwVaypBhRYMZ_XF1xBSq-p13zVmPJmI7Q">.
    <ul>
      <li><strong>To upload a supported file from your device</strong>: click Files <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7F81WckVz8ZLqCRQdkskz29zM_CbUslXVGROonY91A4QqHRxJkAEmRfnOYX1T87mPUAq=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7F81WckVz8ZLqCRQdkskz29zM_CbUslXVGROonY91A4QqHRxJkAEmRfnOYX1T87mPUAq">.</li>
      <li>You can click, drag, and drop images from&nbsp;a web page.&nbsp;</li>
      <li>You can copy and paste images&nbsp;from a webpage.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click Submit <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/T4zQF8HcCskdcuo_Smy7nQMd4eFhzR3qhM0tD5yEt6LkjmOloKKpfkBTDbLpxI0-vg=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/T4zQF8HcCskdcuo_Smy7nQMd4eFhzR3qhM0tD5yEt6LkjmOloKKpfkBTDbLpxI0-vg">.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>

<h3 id="upload_limits">File types &amp; upload limits</h3>

<div><ul>
  <li>Gemini Apps support most file types.</li>
  <li>Up to 10 files (subject to availability) can be uploaded in the same prompt. When uploading a folder, each file inside will count towards this limit.</li>
  <li>Each video can be up to 2 GB. All other supported file types can be up to 100 MB.</li>
  <li>Total video length can be up to 5 minutes. Upgrade to Google AI Pro or Google AI Ultra to extend total upload length to 1 hour.</li>
  <li>Total audio length can be up to 10 minutes. Upgrade to Google AI Pro or Google AI Ultra to extend total upload length to 3 hours.</li>
  <li>One code folder, or one GitHub repository, with up to 5,000 files and a maximum size of 100 MB, can be added to a chat. <a href="/gemini/answer/16176929" rel="noopener">Learn more about adding GitHub repositories</a>.</li>
  <li>ZIP files:
    <ul>
      <li>Can contain up to 10 files (subject to availability).&nbsp;</li>
      <li>Can be up to 100 MB.</li>
      <li>Can’t include video or audio files.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>
</div>

<div>
  <h2>Create a chart based on your data</h2>

  <div><p>You can ask the Gemini web app to create a chart based on your uploaded spreadsheet(s), zoom in to explore the chart, and customize the chart for your needs.</p>
</div>

  <h3>Customize a chart</h3>

  <div><ol>
  <li>Below the chart, tap Edit <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/4ABPcUgldlpLZCiDerdJgbaxZL3ru3yIWDq3HKeZO35yngsVxP83Ue9IQM2e-p6bces=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/4ABPcUgldlpLZCiDerdJgbaxZL3ru3yIWDq3HKeZO35yngsVxP83Ue9IQM2e-p6bces">.&nbsp;</li>
  <li>Choose how you want the chart to change. For example, you can edit&nbsp; things like the chart type and labels.&nbsp;</li>
  <li>Tap&nbsp;Update.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>


<div class="no-margin"><h2>File upload error messages</h2>
<a class="zippy" id="delete_data" name="delete_data">"Delete data to upload file"</a>

<div>
  <div><p>Gemini Apps have a storage limit for data saved from previous Gemini Apps activity, including your chats and any files you’ve uploaded to Gemini Apps. This limit is independent from your Google Drive or Google Workspace storage limit. If you reach your storage limit in Gemini Apps, you'll get this error message and you won’t be able to upload files until you clear some storage space.</p>

<h3>How to clear storage space in Gemini Apps</h3>

<h4>If you have a personal Google Account</h4>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> Chats or Gems with uploaded files such as videos, photos, or files from Google Drive or NotebookLM take up more storage space in Gemini Apps.&nbsp;</p>

<p>To delete your Gemini Apps activity to clear storage space:</p>

<ol>
  <li>Visit <a href="https://gemini.googlecom" rel="noopener">gemini.google.com</a></li>
  <li>Click or tap&nbsp;Settings &amp; help <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Activity <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/FGmr1n7-MbJ4sa2MVEDaBkk8xOuWIvf0ACbZ4h6A5477ey-rt05BWF-zGF_pmc7LddE=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/FGmr1n7-MbJ4sa2MVEDaBkk8xOuWIvf0ACbZ4h6A5477ey-rt05BWF-zGF_pmc7LddE">.</li>
  <li>Choose the Gemini Apps activity your want to delete.</li>
</ol>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> It may take several minutes for deleted Gemini Apps activity or deleted Gems to clear storage space. If you get the same error message, try waiting before you upload a new file. If you still get the error message, try deleting additional Gemini Apps Activity or Gems.</p>

<h4>If you have a Workspace account through work, school, or another organization</h4>

<p>Only a Workspace administrator can delete Gemini Apps activity for a work or school account. <a href="https://​support.google.com/gemini/answer/14620100#work_school_activity" rel="noopener">Learn more about Gemini Apps activity for work and school users</a>.<br>
  <br>
  Contact your administrator to delete Gemini Apps Activity to free up space. <a href="https://support.google.com/a/answer/6208960" rel="noopener">Learn how to find your administrator.</a></p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="upload_limit_reached" name="upload_limit_reached">“You’ve reached your limit for chats with files”</a>

<div>
  <div><p>There are rolling limits for how much you can upload and analyze files in a period of time. After some time, the limit will reset, and you will be able to upload and analyze files again.</p>
If you would like to upload and analyze more files, try again later or <a href="/gemini/answer/14517446" rel="noopener">upgrade to Google AI Pro or Google AI Ultra</a>&nbsp;for higher usage limits.</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="large_upload" name="large_upload">“Your uploads may be too large for the best results”</a>

<div>
  <div><p>If you try to upload a file that is too large, Gemini may provide a response that misses connections or details throughout the content. This is most relevant for prompts that require attention to many details scattered throughout large file(s).</p>

<p>For better results, upload smaller files with less content, or <a href="/gemini/answer/14517446" rel="noopener">upgrade to Google AI Pro or Google AI Ultra</a>&nbsp;for a larger 1 million token context window.</p>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> If you use Deep Think, there is a 192 thousand token window. <a href="/gemini/answer/16345172" rel="noopener"><u>Learn more about using Deep Think</u></a>.&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="context_window" name="context_window">What does it mean when my prompt exceeds the context window?</a>

<div>
  <div><p>If you’re using Gemini Apps with a work or school Google Account, you might get a message that you’ve exceeded the context window for uploading and analyzing files.</p>
</div>

  <h4>What is a context window?</h4>

  <div><p>When you upload files to Gemini Apps, it needs to "read" the content to provide useful insights or answers. The context window is like the reading capacity. It determines how much content can be understood together at one time.</p>
</div>

  <h4>What does it mean when my prompt exceeds the context window?</h4>

  <div><p>A larger context window allows Gemini to read and comprehend more. For example, with a 1M token context window, Gemini can understand up to 1,500 pages of text or 30,000 lines of code.</p>

<p>If you exceed the context window, this could lead to responses that don’t take into account all the content provided or miss connections or details throughout the content. This is most relevant for prompts that require attention to many details scattered throughout large files.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
